application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference appeal reference APP/Q5300/W/22/3300255 (21/01248/FUL): external finishing materials (3 a, d, e, f, h, j, k) in respect of demolition of existing public house (sui-generis) and construction of part 3, part 4, part 5 storey residential building (Class C3) with ground floor public house (Use Class E / Sui-generis) and associated cycle and car parking, refuse storage and external landscaping.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 3 a, d, e, f, h, j, k (external finishing materials) of planning permission ref: 21/01248/FUL as the proposed single colour 'stone effect' aluminium cladding is of a poorer quality and conflicts with the original planning permission and is detrimental to character and appearance of the host property and the immediately surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 of the London Plan (2024), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
